result.requirement: The system shall enable customers to create, validate, and submit order requests containing selected items, quantities, and delivery instructions.
result.business_need: This requirement ensures customers can accurately define their purchase needs and delivery preferences to initiate the fulfillment process.
functional_behaviour: The system shall allow the Customer to select items from the Product Catalog and specify quantities.
The system shall capture delivery instructions and contact details provided by the Customer.
The system shall validate item availability and calculate delivery fees based on the Delivery Zone Map.
The system shall display a summary of the Order Request for Customer confirmation before submission.
The system shall generate a unique Order Request record upon successful validation and submission.
The system shall notify the Customer of the order status and estimated delivery window.
related_information_requirements: The specific list of items selected by the customer, their quantities, unit prices, and any special handling notes or delivery preferences provided by the customer.
Verified details about the ordering individual, including unique identifiers, delivery addresses, and primary contact methods (phone, email).
Calculated estimates of travel duration and distance between the store location and potential customer addresses, accounting for traffic patterns and route constraints.
business_rules: An Order Request cannot be submitted if any selected item is out of stock in the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot.
Delivery fees must be calculated based on the distance between the Store Partner and the delivery address within the Delivery Zone Map.
An Order Request is considered invalid if required customer contact information is missing or incomplete.
Special handling notes provided by the Customer must be stored and visible to the Fulfillment Supervisor during task assignment.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer selects valid items with available stock and enters a complete delivery address
acceptance_criteria.when: The customer submits the order request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system creates a valid Order Request and displays a success confirmation with an estimated delivery window

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer attempts to add an item that is currently out of stock
acceptance_criteria.when: The customer submits the order request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the submission and displays an error message indicating the item is unavailable
